decisions.summary: class FieldGrave, key 'field grave'; both drawers (island and corner) tag their ink 'field grave'
decisions.why: The request's core: the page class key and name no longer name one form; FR-001. Diff matches (water_and_ways.py, features.py four ink tags).

decisions.summary: place.json key, siblings.json keys and two texts reworded, modal file moved to field-grave.md with Name: field grave
decisions.why: place.json and siblings.json are named in the request; the sibling reword makes the text true of both forms (the request's purpose) and is carried by FR-002; the modal's stem is the key's slug, so the move is the rename itself.

decisions.summary: SINCE_189['grave island'] = ('field grave',); frozen snapshot not edited
decisions.why: The request names the snapshot 'through SINCE_189, the renaming table'; FR-004.

decisions.summary: Kashikawa and Mizuguchi regenerated; Kashikawa's ink_classes and notes key follow; Mizuguchi's dated 2026-08-16 history mentioning 'a grave island' stays
decisions.why: Both manifests are named in the request; Mizuguchi's manifest names no grave class at HEAD (measured: its ink_classes carry no grave key). The kept history line is a dated run log describing an island-form grave, not a class key, hover or notes key, so the request (the hover and class naming) does not reach it.

decisions.summary: The island FORM keeps its name: grave_form=island, its choice modal, _plot_grave_island, and the glossary term 'grave island'
decisions.why: The request lists 'the glossary term' among what the rename touches, so keeping it narrows the literal list. Purpose-level: the request exists because a corner-form hamlet is told its grave is an island; the glossary term's definition (read at HEAD) is 'a grave standing inside a field plot ... the Chinese form of the field grave' - it names the FORM. Renamed to 'field grave' it would define every field grave as a mid-plot mound, reintroducing on the corner-form map exactly the contradiction the request removes. Applying the list literally defeats the request's stated purpose; the class/form seam is checked item by item (choice modal, drawer name and glossary term all name the island form only). Carried by FR-003, accepted at spec round 2.

decisions.summary: impl-drift on renamed claims, modal-form on the renamed modal; research/depiction checks not re-run; the owed glyph-check over an unchanged glyph answered with an escape and reason
decisions.why: Process for verifying a rename, not a change to what the GM asked; nothing the request asks for is withheld by it (glyph, About, Guesses and Depiction are unchanged per FR-002). Whether the escape is sound is the gate's question, not fidelity.
